name: Simple Tablet
summary: At the Valley of Trials, Gornek gives new troll warriors a message to take to Frang.

sections.title: A Summons to Battle
sections.body: Gornek gives new troll warriors a message from Tar'sere, addressed to Frang, the warrior trainer near the Den. It introduces the recruit to combat training in Durotar and asks them to present themselves to Frang. The message calls on them to take up weapons for the Horde.

faq.answer: Gornek gives aspiring troll warriors in the Valley of Trials a message that directs them to Frang for combat training.
Tar'sere signs the message and directs the recruit to Frang, the warrior trainer outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Where do I take the tablet?
aliases: who do i give simple tablet to
faq.answer: Take the Simple Tablet to Frang, who rests outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
The Simple Tablet is given to troll warriors beginning their rites of passage in the Valley of Trials.

angles.text: As a warrior, the tablet introduces you to Frang for combat training.
As a Darkspear troll in Durotar, this summons calls you to strengthen the Horde's frontline ranks alongside the orcs.
